claims.text: A tutor reports that a Vietnamese diacritic is replaced with a question mark in the downloaded EX-51 CSV while it looks correct in the browser preview.
A tutor reports that EX-67 displays a missing accent in one editor while the web preview retains it, and says that no other editor has been checked yet.
In the EX-51 thread, the team lead asks for the original export to be saved and the application name recorded, and says where the change happens has not been established.
In the EX-67 thread, the team lead instructs the tutor to download from Export History, keep the original file, try a UTF-8 editor, and report whether the downloaded text still differs.

The current project troubleshooting FAQ directs preserving the downloaded CSV, comparing its original bytes or a UTF-8-aware rendering with the web preview, recording the export ID and viewer, and keeping the cause open until the original is checked.

The supplied threads end with the team lead's diagnostic requests; they contain neither the requested EX-51 file and application details nor an EX-67 UTF-8 check result, so neither report has a demonstrated resolution.
